notes.title: Monster Energy Supercross 3 – Patch Note #5
notes.content:
Hi riders,

here we are, to share with you the latest updates introduced by this patch fixed the annoying reset of the online settings between races. Now you can focus more on just racing!

Other fixes

– Future add-ons support
– Minor changes on weather
– Minor fixes to customization items
– Minor UI fixes

notes.title: Join the Official Teams!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031530/3914f980b48d237cdb1184bc9ddcc2223d537c75.gif

For the first time ever, you can finally join the official teams!

But it will be a tough challenge because you will have to face the boot camps to determine which teams you can enter.
Are you ready to win the best contract? Find out all you will be able to do once you join the team.
Watch the full video and Be one of us!
